svg.title: 09 Core and custom modeling inputs
svg.text: Core uses DataContract. Custom runs use DataContract AND Custom Configuration.
Core models Bronze into Silver. Each new custom calculation loads both independent definitions before processing its source model. Proposed design.
1 · CORE PHASE — DataContract defines the parameters used to model Bronze into Silver
Read Bronze values using the parameter mappings supplied by DataContract
Python uses DataContract to extract, type and validate the model parameters and resolve Core functions.
The example maps the Bronze field DeathPenatly to the calculation parameter DeathPenatly.
Save frozen Bronze input + DataContract version/hash + Core execution plan + queued run
Saved run → Python dispatch service → Amazon SQS FIFO → Python worker; load the frozen Core plan.
Vue polls Litestar for the saved outcome and displays Silver { DeathPenatly: 800 }.
A later custom calculation selects this Silver model as its source.
2 · CUSTOM PHASE — Python requires BOTH DataContract AND Custom Configuration
par · INDEPENDENT READS — neither read depends on the other
Read DataContract for this new run
Regional Calculation; DeathPenatly override 700; factor 0.90; released custom SQL
JOIN · wait for BOTH reads. Python checks configuration compatibility with DataContract.
An invalid or missing input stops acceptance; neither document alone is the complete custom plan.
Read the selected Silver source model
Python combines source + DataContract + Custom Configuration.
Configured override replaces 800 with 700 for this run; the stored Silver model remains 800.
Save frozen input 700 + BOTH document revisions/hashes + resolved custom plan + queued run
Python dispatch service → Amazon SQS FIFO → worker; load the complete frozen custom plan.
GOLD · new custom result, with source / DataContract / Custom Configuration lineage
Every NEW custom calculation reads both documents independently. A RETRY reuses the same frozen input, DataContract, Custom Configuration and plan.
DataContract supplies the model definition and Core rules. Custom Configuration supplies the selected custom process, overrides and calculation settings.
